text.description_html:
Acorn AL9BR, Lift Bar Latch Set

For use on a flush door, the Lift Bar Latch Set is perfect for securing lightweight doors of all kinds including closet doors, cabinets, and gates. It has a knob for easy gripping and lifts in and out of the bar guide for a secure fit. It has a matte black finish and that, along with the old world styling, makes this latch great for traditional and rustic decors.

Features and Specifications for the Bar Latch Set:

  • Material: Iron
  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Bar Guide Height: 2"
  • Lever Length: 4"
  • Package Includes: 1 bar guide, 1 bar, 1 rim strike, and mounting screws.
  • Lifetime no rust warranty.

Sold Individually
